title: COG painted by TiTiler — test fixture
description: Two scenes of a COG, painted server-side by TiTiler's /cog router and walked with the clock. Points at a host that does not resolve: it draws only under the end-to-end proxy.

options.content:
> **Test fixture.** This board points at `titiler.test`, a host that does not resolve. It exists so the end-to-end suite can intercept its requests; opened by hand the map stays empty, and that is correct.

# A COG painted by the server

Two scenes of an invented COG. Unlike kepler's raster layer, which asks for `.npy` and colours in the browser, here the panel asks the `/cog` router for `.png` and the server applies the palette the file carries inside it.

It is the only thing that works for a **classified** raster: with nine classes numbered 1-11, the shader's rescaling takes them all to the same colour and the map comes out a flat single tone.
